narrator.how: quiet, measured, a little hollow — the way one recalls what one would rather forget
narrator.name: the narrator, Roderick’s childhood friend

roderick.how: nervous, impetuous — now almost a whisper, now breaking off
roderick.name: Roderick Usher

madeline.how: barely audible, slow, in a whisper, as if from far away
madeline.name: the Lady Madeline, Roderick’s twin sister

doctor.how: ingratiating, with a greedy curiosity, a little fawning
doctor.name: the Ushers’ physician, elderly
